title: Revert My String!
description: Reverts the string texture back to what it was in 1.21.11.
body:
Reverts the string texture back to what it was before 26.1-snapshot 3

This resource pack helps to make string less visible like it was before in 1.21.11. It helps builders continue using string to block snow or other things from ruining a build.
